topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When I opened the door and saw the small, unassuming package on my doorstep, I couldn’t help but smile. It had clearly seen some miles, the box a bit worn around the edges, but it was still neatly addressed. To my surprise, the name and address were for the person who used to live here, not me. I took it in, thinking of the journey it had made, hoping it was important. I decided to do a bit of detective work. A quick call to the forwarding number on the post office's website, and I found out where it should go. As I drove to the address, I imagined the happiness of receiving a package you thought might have been lost. Handing it over, the recipient’s face lit up, and I felt a warm satisfaction, knowing I’d played a small part in ensuring it reached the right hands.
